metadata.title: We should not mark non-floating point Tensors as requirering gradients, ever

trigger_conditions.condition: Applying non-differentiable operators such as argmax/argmin to tensors with requires_grad=True and checking whether gradient state is incorrectly propagated to integer outputs.
trigger_conditions.operation_context: A floating-point tensor with requires_grad=True is passed to torch.argmax or torch.argmin, producing an integer tensor that incorrectly retains requires_grad=True.

failure_behavior.description: A floating-point tensor with requires_grad=True is passed to torch.argmax or torch.argmin, producing an integer tensor that incorrectly retains requires_grad=True.
